evals.name: eval-lms-default
evals.prompt: Genere-moi des requetes conversationnelles IA pour le pilier LMS WordPress. Je veux identifier les questions que mes lecteurs posent a ChatGPT sur les formations en ligne avec WordPress.
evals.expected_output: 10 requetes FR avec intentions, formats, 5 denominateurs, 3 angles de preuve

assertions.text: At least 3 different content formats used
Each query contains at least 2 explicit constraints
All queries are natural language (>10 words)

evals.name: eval-coach-custom
evals.prompt: Je cible des coachs sportifs qui veulent vendre leurs programmes en ligne avec WordPress. Donne-moi 15 requetes AI search qu'ils poseraient a Perplexity, avec les formats de contenu pour maximiser les citations.
evals.expected_output: 15 requetes FR avec audience coach sportif, intentions, formats, 5 denominateurs, 3 angles de preuve

assertions.text: At least 3 different content formats used
Each query contains at least 2 explicit constraints
All queries are natural language (>10 words)
Queries relevant to sports coaches (not generic WordPress)

evals.name: eval-woo-minimal-en
evals.prompt: I need 5 AI search queries that WooCommerce store owners would ask ChatGPT about automating their e-commerce operations. Skip the proof angles, just the queries with intentions and formats.
evals.expected_output: 5 requetes EN WooCommerce, pas d'angles de preuve, intentions et formats presents

assertions.text: At least 3 different intention types used
At least 2 different content formats used
Each query contains at least 2 explicit constraints
2 main sections: Denominateurs and Requetes only
All queries are natural language (>10 words)
